IN-STAT-0001.text: Bees and poultry count as animals under the Act. The definition of 'animal' includes 'cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat, yak, mithun; dog, cat, pig, horse, camel, ass, mule, poultry, bees;' as per section 2(a)(ii) of provision [1].

IN-STAT-0003.text: The provisions of this Part shall apply to the Union territories and shall, in their application to a Union territory, have effect as if the references to the Governor of a State were references to the Administrator of the Union territory appointed under article 239

IN-STAT-0004.text: A Hindu child is treated as a minor up to the age of 'eighteen years' as per section 4(a) of the Hindu Minority and Guardianship Act, 1956.

IN-STAT-0007.text: For the upper house created by statute for Tamil Nadu in 2010, the meaning of undefined words is found in the Representation of the People Act, 1950, as per section 2 of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Council Act, 2010.

IN-STAT-0008.text: In Manipur's levy on fuel and engine lubricants, 'crude oil' covers unrefined petroleum, and 'greases' are taxed as lubricants. This is defined in section 2(e) of the Manipur (Sales of Motor Spirit and Lubricants) Taxation Act, 1962, which states that 'lubricant' includes all forms of greases.

IN-STAT-0013.text: The inner wrapping that touches food is specified as 'food grade material' and must conform to Indian Standards specifications, while the outer layer is not subject to the same direct food contact requirements. This distinction is outlined in the Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulation, 2018.

IN-STAT-0014.text: Yes, a staged show streamed live on television falls within what the broadcast-advertising limits treat as programming. "any audio or visual or audio-visual live performance or presentation" is included in the definition of 'programme' under [2] and [5].

IN-STAT-0015.text: A 'family of models' is defined as 'group of models for which all the performance parameters are same' under [1] Pt. III, s. 2 (b).

IN-STAT-0016.text: No, daily-wage workers are not counted as employees under the Bureau of Indian Standards' rules on its Director General's powers. The provision states: 'employee' means officers and employees in the whole time service of the Bureau but does not include a person employed on daily wages (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0018.text: The Appellate Authority, which is the Secretary to the Government of India in the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, decides challenges to decisions made under the 2026 framework for internet gaming.

IN-STAT-0019.text: An 'investor' means any person, who has committed money in shares, or debentures, bond or deposits under a scheme or plan of a company registered under the Act.

IN-STAT-0020.text: Yes, 'Chairman' includes someone holding the post temporarily. 'Chairman' means the Chairman of a Board and includes the temporary Chairman and President of the Municipal Council.

IN-STAT-0021.text: The Sanctioning Authority sanctions a Goa legislator's advance for buying a new car.

IN-STAT-0022.text: The officer must hold a rank not below that of Group II Inspector by whatever designation called.

IN-STAT-0023.text: In Karnataka's civil service rules, being appointed 'on probation' means 'appointed on trial' as defined in the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977, s. 2 (1) and also in the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, s. 2 (1) (a).

IN-STAT-0026.text: The Board is 'the Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad' as established under section 3 (1) of Uttar Pradesh Avas Evam Vikas Parishad Adhiniyam, 1965.

IN-STAT-0028.text: Yes, cars that a diplomat imports are tax-free under the customs concession for foreign envoys, as per 'goods means all articles imported or purchased locally from bonded stocks free of duty in accordance with the notification referred to in sub-rule (3) of rule 1' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0029.text: The Chairman of the District Panchayat shall be the exofficio member in all the Standing Committees constituted by the District Panchayat.

IN-STAT-0030.text: The managing 'committee' of such a body means the governing body of a co-operative society by whatever name called, to which the management of the affairs of the society is entrusted.

IN-STAT-0031.text: Yes, the heir of a trader who has died can use Goa's 2023 one-time scheme to clear old tax dues, as the term 'applicant' includes 'legal heir' under section 2(b) of the Goa (Recovery of Arrears of Tax, Interest, Penalty, Other Dues through Settlement) Act, 2023.

IN-STAT-0032.text: Yes, using a wireless gadget counts as 'unfair means' as per 'the use of any unauthorized telephonic, wireless or electronic or other instrument or gadget' under section 2(c) of the Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1992 and section 2(f)(i) of the Rajasthan Public Examination (Measures for Prevention of Unfair Means in Recruitment) Act, 2022. The examination centre extends to 'the entire premises attached thereto' under section 2(a) of the Rajasthan Public Examination (Prevention of Unfair Means) Act, 1992.

IN-STAT-0034.text: Yes, statues of the deity and offerings given on temple grounds belong to the trust property of the two Jammu and Kashmir Devi shrines. This is because 'Endowment' includes 'offerings made to any of the deities comprised in the Shrines' (Provision [1] s. 3(h)).

IN-STAT-0035.text: Not more than one-twentieth part is covered with buildings.

IN-STAT-0036.text: No, the tenant cannot claim compensation for a makeshift well as an improvement under the Kerala Compensation for Tenants Improvements Act, 1958. 'Temporary wells and water-channels as are made by the tenant in the ordinary course of cultivation and without any special expenditure or any other benefit accruing to land from the ordinary operations of husbandry' are excluded from the definition of 'improvement' under section 2(b).

IN-STAT-0037.text: A 'goonda' is a person who either by himself or as a member or leader of a gang habitually commits or attempts to commit or abets the commission of an offence under section 294 or under Chapter XVI, Chapter XVII or Chapter XXII of the Indian Penal Code, or is so desperate and dangerous as to render his being at large in a particular area hazardous or nuisance to the community.

IN-STAT-0039.text: The Madhya Pradesh Extension of Laws Act, 1958 (No. 23 of 1958) supplies the meaning of words it leaves undefined.

IN-STAT-0040.text: The university was constituted under the "Gandhiji University Act, 1985 (12 of 1985)".

IN-STAT-0042.text: A 'Bulk user of water' is defined as any person whose consumption of water exceeds '3000 cubic meters per day' as per section 2(1A) of the Goa Irrigation Act, 1973.

IN-STAT-0043.text: In the Rajasthan Official Language Act, 1956, 'the State' means 'the new State of Rajasthan as formed by section 10 of the States Reorganisation Act, 1956 (Central Act 37 of 1956)' as per section 2(1).

IN-STAT-0044.text: Raising cattle for milk is not considered agricultural under the Himachal Pradesh Town and Country Planning Act, 1977 as it excludes 'keeping of cattle purely for the purpose of milking and selling the milk and milk products'. Running a plant nursery is considered agricultural under the Kota Development Authority Act, 2023 as it falls under 'use of land as a nursery' in the definition of 'agriculture'.

IN-STAT-0045.text: Yes, a courtesy pass counts as a 'ticket' under the Himachal Pradesh Prevention of Ticketless Travel in Road Transport Service Act, 1976. 'ticket' includes a duty, privilege or courtesy pass issued under the authority of the State Transport Undertaking.

IN-STAT-0048.text: An appeal against any refusal, admission or determination under sections seven, eight or nine shall lie, if preferred within six weeks from the date of such determination, to the Commissioner of Division to whom the Manager is subordinate, and the decision of such Commissioner, or of the Manager if no such appeal has been so preferred, shall be final.

IN-STAT-0050.text: The maximum imprisonment for coaxing a married woman to leave her husband for an illicit relationship is 'imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to two years' under section 498 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

IN-STAT-0052.text: The person so compelled shall report the matter to the law enforcement authority or investigating agency within a period of seven days from the date of giving such undue advantage. The maximum sentence for offering a bribe is imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years or with fine or with both.

IN-STAT-0053.text: The period of such deputation shall in no case extend beyond a period of three years from the appointed day.

IN-STAT-0054.text: The lease of such land is for a period of thirty years or more.

IN-STAT-0055.text: The longest period for which a person can be ordered to stay out of the capital by an externment direction is 'not exceeding six months' as may be specified in the order.

IN-STAT-0056.text: If any person enters the signal-room of a telegraph office without permission of competent authority, he shall be punished with fine which may extend to five hundred rupees.

IN-STAT-0057.text: The minimum prison term for wilfully trying to dodge the tax on high spending in hotels is 'rigorous imprisonment for a term which shall not be less than three months' as per section 26(1)(ii) of the Hotel-Receipts Tax Act, 1980 and section 18(1) of the Assam Tax on Luxuries (Hotels and Lodging Houses) Act, 1989.

IN-STAT-0059.text: The Central Government had to adapt existing laws by order within "two years from the appointed day" as provided in 'High Court at Bombay (Extension of Jurisdiction to Goa, Daman and Diu) Act, 1981 — s. 14' and 'Goa, Daman and Diu (Administration) Act, 1962 — s. 5'.

IN-STAT-0062.text: A private citizen must give notice of not less than sixty days, in the manner prescribed, of the alleged offence and of his intention to make a complaint, to the Central Government or the authority or officer authorised as aforesaid.

IN-STAT-0064.text: For a period of one year from that day

IN-STAT-0065.text: Every owner of land planted with cardamom plants shall, before the expiration of one month from the date on which he first became owner of such estate or estates, apply to the registering officer for registration.

IN-STAT-0066.text: If, after issue of a notice under section 6, the prescribed authority fails to certify within the prescribed time, the Court may, if it thinks fit, continue the proceeding.

IN-STAT-0067.text: The appeal must be filed within "thirty days from the date on which the order made by the Magistrate is served on the aggrieved person or the respondent, as the case may be, whichever is later."

IN-STAT-0068.text: The punishment for performing phooka on a cow to increase its milk is a fine which may extend to one thousand rupees, or with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years, or with both, and the animal on which the operation was performed shall be forfeited to the Government.

IN-STAT-0070.text: The first Vice-Chancellor, the first Registrar and the first Finance Officer shall hold office for a period to be fixed by him but not exceeding three years.

IN-STAT-0071.text: A member who has held two consecutive terms of office shall be eligible for re-nomination only after the expiry of a period of two years from the date he ceases to be member of the Pension Advisory Committee.

IN-STAT-0072.text: The person elected as a shareholder’s director under sub-regulation (8) shall be appointed by the Board for a term of four years and shall be eligible for re-election and re-appointment for another term of four years as referred to in regulation 4.

IN-STAT-0073.text: A subject disposed of by the Institute at a meeting shall not be brought up again for consideration until after the expiry of one year, except in a case where the President or Government certifies that the subject required further consideration in the interest of the Institute.

IN-STAT-0074.text: For ship-hull cover, 100 percent of Net Written Premium during the preceding twelve months must be set aside for policies still running.

IN-STAT-0075.text: A consumer may file an appeal to the appellate authority within 30 days of the final assessment order, as per 'within 30 days of the order' quoted from provision [3]. The consumer must first deposit an amount equal to half of the assessed amount, as stated in 'No appeal shall be entertained unless an amount equal to 1[half] of the assessed amount is deposited' from provision [3].

IN-STAT-0076.text: The insurance broker shall within 21 days from the date of receipt of communication respond to the Authority.

IN-STAT-0077.text: The records relating to the requests referred to in sub-regulation (1) shall be retained by the distributor of television channels for a minimum period of three months from the date of receipt of such request from the subscriber.

IN-STAT-0078.text: The over-drawal/under-drawal of electricity by any buyer during the time block shall not exceed 12% of its scheduled drawal, when grid frequency is '49.85Hz' and above but "below 50.05 Hz".

IN-STAT-0080.text: Every grid operator shall undergo training in real time digital simulator and a refresher course at least once in two years.

IN-STAT-0081.text: Every broadcaster shall, within sixty days of receipt of written request from a distributor of television channels for obtaining signals of television channel or within thirty days of signing of interconnection agreement with the distributor, as the case may be, provide, on non-discriminatory basis, the signals of television channel to the distributor.

IN-STAT-0082.text: The longest ban a customs chief can impose on a clearing agent for neglecting duties at a port is not explicitly stated in the provided provisions. However, under the Customs House Agents Licensing Regulations, 1984, s. 22, the Commissioner may prohibit any Custom House Agent from working in one or more sections of the Customs Station.

IN-STAT-0083.text: The staff of a partner institution must have a minimum of three years’ research or teaching experience or both to become adjunct faculty of the Faridabad biotechnology centre. This is specified in 'only the regular research and academic staff of the Recognised Centre having Doctor of Philosophy or Doctor of Medicine degree with a minimum of three years’ research or teaching experience or both shall be eligible for recognition as an adjunct faculty of the Regional Centre' (citation: 1).

IN-STAT-0085.text: Existing private warehouses had to meet the new requirements within a period of three months from the date of commencement of these regulations.

IN-STAT-0086.text: For a minimum period of two years or such other period as may be determined by the Central Government, telecom companies must preserve logs and documentation of the telecommunication network architecture of Critical Telecommunication Infrastructure.

IN-STAT-0087.text: The heir must have attained the age of eighteen years within three years from the date of death of the person deceased and he must make an application within two years thereafter.

IN-STAT-0090.text: A member expelled from a cooperative must wait for a period of 'two years from the date of such expulsion' before being eligible for re-admission to any registered society, as per 'Bihar Cooperative Societies Rules, 1959 — s. 11' and 'Gujarat Cooperative societies Act-1961 — text'.

IN-STAT-0091.text: The notice for meeting shall be issued in such manner so as to reach the chairperson and members at least three days in advance.

IN-STAT-0092.text: The costs of the application are in the discretion of the Court or Judge under section 7(1) of the Bankers Books Evidence Act, 1891. A bank employee may not be forced to bring the books unless ordered by the Court or Judge under section 6(1) of the Act.

IN-STAT-0093.text: The Indian Statistical Institute must provide facilities to the Committee under section 9, and the panel may review the work done by the Institute, inspect its assets, evaluate its work, and advise the Government on matters of importance. "The Institute shall be bound to afford all necessary facilities to any Committee constituted under section 8 or section 9" (s. 10).

IN-STAT-0094.text: The Centre can cancel a licence for a new factory if a person or authority fails to establish or take effective steps to establish the new industrial undertaking within the specified time, as per section 12(1) of the Industries (Development and Regulation) Act, 1951. No person or authority other than the Central Government may set up such an undertaking without a licence, as per section 11(1) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0098.text: The amount of compensation shall be determined in accordance with section 21 but in calculating the compensation payable, no account shall be taken of the value of any uranium contained in the substance referred to in sub-section (1).

IN-STAT-0099.text: Bihar ceded the territories specified in sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Bihar and West Bengal (Transfer of Territories) Act, 1956, to its eastern neighbour. The constitutional description of the two states was altered by including the territories specified in clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 3 of the Bihar and Uttar Pradesh (Alteration of Boundaries) Act, 1968, and excluding those specified in the Bihar and West Bengal (Transfer of Territories) Act, 1956.

IN-STAT-0101.text: The Commission must submit its annual report to the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change by December every year, as per 'Submission of Annual Report' in regulation 2. The report is then laid in the Parliament.

IN-STAT-0102.text: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board appoints an Investigating Officer to investigate complaints. Complaints of individual consumers maintainable before a consumer disputes redressal forum under the Consumer Protection Act, 1986 shall not be taken up by the Board but shall be heard and disposed of by such forum.

IN-STAT-0103.text: The governing board of the Chennai dance and arts foundation must meet at least twice in a year, and the quorum is one third of the total members, as laid down in 'The Governing Council shall meet as often as necessary but at least twice in a year' and 'The quorum of such meeting shall be one third of the total member' (citations: [1]).

IN-STAT-0104.text: The confirming authority may mitigate, remit or commute the sentence to one lower in the scale laid down in section 47, or set aside the proceedings if found illegal. 'While confirming the finding, the confirming authority may either unconditionally or subject to conditions which the accused accepts, reduce or remit a portion of the sentence or commute the punishment to one given lower in the scale of punishments in section 47.' (citations: [1], [4], [5])

IN-STAT-0105.text: A person accused of the crime of apartheid can be tried in any place in which he may be found or in such other place as the Central Government may direct. The heaviest punishment is death.

IN-STAT-0106.text: The integrated GST law is treated as extended to Jammu and Kashmir from the date of commencement of the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (Extension to Jammu and Kashmir) Act, 2017, which is "the 8th day of July, 2017". The exclusion removed is "except the State of Jammu and Kashmir*" from section 1, sub-section (2) of the principal Act.

IN-STAT-0107.text: The authority managing a national highway can shut it to traffic for a while if it considers it proper for the purposes of section 31 or 32, as stated in 'Where, in exercise of the powers under section 31 or section 32, the Highway Administration considers it proper for the purposes of that section to temporarily close a Highway...' (citations: [1], [2], [3], [5]).

IN-STAT-0108.text: Yes, the ban on unauthorised use of the Red Cross emblem applies on an Indian ship at sea. The use of the emblem on Indian ships or aircraft requires the approval of the Central Government, as stated in 'No person shall, without the approval of the Central Government, use...'

IN-STAT-0111.text: The national council for training disability professionals must meet at least once in a year, as per "An annual meeting of the Council shall be held at least once in a year" (Provision 1). Its procedural rules are made by the Chairperson, as per "such time and place as the Chairperson may decide" (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0112.text: A company that bought a trade receivable can demand payment from the buyer only after giving notice of the assignment to the debtor, as per 'Any assignee of a receivable shall not be entitled to demand payment of the receivable from the debtor in respect of such receivables unless notice of such assignment is given to the debtor by the assignor or the assignee along with express authority in its favors granted by the assignor' (Provision [1]). Paying the original seller stops discharging the debt if the debtor has not received notice of the assignment, as illustrated in 'B then demands the debt from A, who, not having received notice of the transfer, as prescribed in section 131, pays B. The payment is valid, and C cannot sue A for the debt' (Provision [4]).

IN-STAT-0114.text: When a multi-state cooperative converts into a farmers' producer company, it requires a majority in number representing three-fourths in value of the creditors or members present and voting, as per section 581ZS(3) of the Companies Act, 1956. Upon conversion, its property shall vest in the farmers' producer company as per the order of the High Court.

IN-STAT-0115.text: The Centre must publish an annual report in the Official Gazette giving an account of the activities financed under section 7A and a statement of accounts. This obligation is specified in 'section 7B Annual report of activities financed under the Fund' (citation 6).

IN-STAT-0116.text: A Prize Court has the same powers as a Civil Court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in respect of summoning witnesses, examining them on oath, requiring discovery of documents, and other matters prescribed by rules, as per 'the same powers as are vested in a Civil Court while trying a suit under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908' (s. 7(1)). Parties have ninety days from the date of the order or decree to appeal to the Central Government, as per 'within a period of ninety days from the date on which such order or decree has been made' (s. 6(1)).

IN-STAT-0119.text: The person who falsely suggests that goods come from a famous region must turn down the brand name. The Registrar of Geographical Indications, who is the Controller-General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, heads the registry of such regional names.

IN-STAT-0120.text: Yes, a waqf's manager may pay the cost of preparing its accounts out of its income, as per 'every mutawalli may pay from the income of the waqf property any expenses properly incurred by him for the purpose of enabling him to furnish any accounts under section 46' (citation: [3]). The accounts must be filed before the '1st day of October' in every year (citation: [2]).

IN-STAT-0121.text: A border force member who abets an offence punishable with death, but which is not committed, is liable to suffer imprisonment for a term which may extend to fourteen years, as per 'Any person subject to this Act who abets the commission of any of the offences punishable with death... shall, on conviction... be liable to suffer imprisonment for a term which may extend to fourteen years' (Provision 1). Offences involving the enemy that carry death are specified in 'Offences in relation to the enemy and punishable with death' (Provision 2).

IN-STAT-0122.text: If one of a Christian couple is a minor and they live in Calcutta, Madras or Bombay, they may apply by petition to a Judge of the High Court for an order upon the Marriage Registrar to issue his certificate before the expiration of the fourteen days required by section 41. The said Marriage Registrar, on receipt of the said order, shall issue his certificate in accordance therewith.

IN-STAT-0123.text: The Government must constitute an Advisory Committee if it decides to make any scheme under section 4. The Advisory Committee shall include an equal number of members representing (i) the Government, (ii) the dock workers, and (iii) the employers of dock workers, and shipping companies.

IN-STAT-0124.text: The Central Government shall give, in cash, to the Treasurer an amount equivalent to the sum of rupees one lakh for the transfer to, and vesting in, the Central Government, under section 3, of the Lady Hardinge Medical College and Hospital. The amount shall be paid within three months from the appointed day.

IN-STAT-0125.text: The person who keeps a common gaming-house is punishable under 's. 3 Punishment for keeping common gaming-house' and may be rewarded with part of the fine under 's. 16 Portion of fine may be paid to informer' or 's. 14 (1) The convicting magistrate may direct any portion'.

IN-STAT-0126.text: Persons eligible for free legal aid include those whose annual income does not exceed Rs. 1 Lakh (or Rs. 1,25,000/- in the Supreme Court Legal Service Committee), as stated in '(h) Persons whose annual income does not exceed Rs. 1 Lakh (in the Supreme Court Legal Service Committee the limit is Rs. 1,25,000/-)' [1]. A sworn statement of income may be sufficient, as per 'An affidavit made by a person as to his income may be regarded as sufficient for making him eligible to the entitlement of legal services under this Act unless the concerned Authority has reason to disbelieve such affidavit.' [5].

IN-STAT-0128.text: A Board shall meet at least once in every three months and shall observe such rules of procedure in regard to the transaction of business at its meetings as may be prescribed. 'the intervals and the time and place at which meetings of the Central Board or of any committee thereof shall be held and the procedure to be followed at such meetings, including the quorum necessary for the transaction of business' is determined by rules made under section 63 and 64.

IN-STAT-0130.text: If development works on one plot also benefit neighbouring land in Delhi, the owners of such other land shall be liable to contribute towards the expenses of carrying out the work such amount as the Board may determine. This contribution shall be recovered from those persons as arrears of land revenue.

IN-STAT-0131.text: Yes, it is a crime to knowingly give shelter to someone who is about to spy. The offence is punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to 'three years', or with fine, or with both, as per 'Official Secrets Act, 1923 — s. 10' and 'Official Secrets Act, 1923 — s. 9'.

IN-STAT-0132.text: The Collector of the district in which any notified area is situated shall depute one or more Revenue officers to accompany the forces engaged in the practice, and the Revenue officer shall determine the amount of compensation, if any, which shall be awarded in each case. "Compensation shall be payable for any damage to person or property or interference with rights or privileges arising from such practice".

IN-STAT-0133.text: The regulator that fixes airport charges consists of 'a Chairperson and two other Members' as per section 4 of the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority of India Act, 2008. The committee that recommends them is chaired by 'Cabinet Secretary' under section 5.

IN-STAT-0134.text: Members of the Jamnagar body for traditional-medicine education, represented by Shri Gulabkunverba Ayurvedic Society, Jamnagar, serve as members of the Senate of Gujarat Ayurved University for as long as they are a teacher of an affiliated college, as per 'every person elected under clause (i) and under sub-clauses (a) and (b) of clause (iii) shall continue to hold office of a member of the Senate only so long as in the case of clause (i) he is a teacher of an affiliated college' (Provision 2). Gujarat's health secretary does not sit on it directly, but the Commissioner of Health, Medical Services and Medical Education, ex-officio, is a member (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0135.text: Copies of rules... shall be exhibited, both in English and in the regional language... to which all persons employed within a prison have access.

IN-STAT-0138.text: A court can take up a charge of lying in import documents without official permission under 'Printing or publication of a proceeding without prior permission of court' under section 1*228A of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973. The maximum punishment is 'Imprisonment for 2 years and fine.'

IN-STAT-0145.text: The notice must be made available in the local language to the Gram Panchayat, Nagar Nigam/Nagar Panchayat/Nagar Palika Parishad, in the offices of the District Collector, the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Office of concerned Land Acquisition Officer, Administrator, Tehsildar, published in two daily newspapers circulating in the affected area (at least one in the regional language), by public notice at conspicuous places in the affected areas, and uploaded on the website of the district or the Government. The Social Impact Assessment study shall be conducted by an independent outsourced district Social Impact Assessment agency, appointed by the State Government or Collector.

IN-STAT-0146.text: A notification appointing an official to collect statistics must state the name, designation and address of the officer, details of any agency engaged, terms and conditions of engagement, form and particulars of statistical information to be furnished, and powers delegated, as per section 7(1) of the Act. The appropriate Government keeps the register of such officials, as per section 8 of the Act.

IN-STAT-0147.text: The Delhi bed-and-breakfast host must furnish the particulars of any foreigner staying in his establishment to the Foreigners’ Registration Officer of the District within twenty-four hours of his checking-in in the Form prescribed under the Registration of Foreigners Rules, 1939. This is mandated under section 5(a) of the Delhi Act 11 of 2007.

IN-STAT-0149.text: When buying farmland in Goa, the buyer must undertake to take up agriculture on the land within three years from the date of acquisition and continue to carry it on agriculture, as per section 3(1) of the Goa Restrictions on Transfer of Agricultural Land Act, 2023. Proof of being a farmer is accepted in the form of a Krishi Card or a Certificate issued by the Mamlatdar, or by an authorized competent authority of any State Government, as per section 3(1) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0151.text: Staff of Maharashtra's board for vocational training are treated as public servants under 'All members, officers and employees of the Board shall, when acting... be deemed to be public servants' (s. 56, [1]). The pay of staff carried over from the old board is governed by the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules or such other rules as may be made by the Government, as per 'during the period of such employment all matters relating to the pay... shall be regulated by the Maharashtra Civil Services Rules' (s. 21(1)(a), [2]).

IN-STAT-0152.text: The fund of Goa's statutory body for building schools and colleges consists of all monies received by the Corporation by way of grants, subventions, loans, advances or otherwise, fees, costs and charges, disposal of lands, buildings and other properties, rents and profits, and proceeds of any loan authorised by section 20. The Corporation may borrow in the open market as provided in section 20 of the Goa Education Development Corporation Act, 2003.

IN-STAT-0153.text: A Tamil Nadu trader using the 2011 scheme for old sales-tax dues gets cleared when the designated authority issues the Certificate of Settlement of arrears under section 8(1) of the Tamil Nadu Sales Tax (Settlement of Arrears) Act, 2011. If the trader paid less than ninety per cent upfront, the designated authority shall summarily reject the application, as per section 6(3) of the Act.

IN-STAT-0155.text: From any order of the Canal-Officer under this section, an appeal shall lie within one month from the date of communication of the order, to the Collector of the district, whose decision thereon shall be final.

IN-STAT-0156.text: A person may appeal to the Karnataka Appellate Tribunal within ninety days from the date of the Deputy Commissioner's decision under sections 8, 16 and 24 of the KARNATAKA (SANDUR AREA) INAMS ABOLITION ACT, 1976. New occupants owe the state any excess payments as arrears of land revenue, as per section 30 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0157.text: The fine for not cancelling an adhesive stamp in Jammu and Kashmir is a penalty which may extend to 'ten thousand rupees' as per section 63 of the STAMP ACT, 1977. Cancellation requires that the stamp be cancelled so that it cannot be used again, as per section 12 of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0158.text: In the eastern Maharashtra region, the ceiling on how much farmland a cultivating lessee may acquire from the owner is determined by the ceiling area specified in section 5 of the Maharashtra Tenancy and Agricultural Lands Act, which states: 'the ceiling area of lands shall be, (a) 48 acres of jirayat land, or (b) 24 acres of seasonally irrigated land or paddy or rice land, or (c) 12 acres of perennially irrigated land.'

IN-STAT-0159.text: Since October 2023, Karnataka's GST penalty provision on e-commerce operators covers 'every electronic commerce operator who is required to collect tax at source under section 52' as per section 24(ix) and (x) of the KGST Act, 2017.

IN-STAT-0160.text: The Industrial Court settles fights over which union gets official recognition in Maharashtra, as per section 14(4) and 12(3) of the Maharashtra Recognition of Trade Unions and Prevention of Unfair Labour Practices Act, 1971. A person found guilty by a labour judge has thirty days within which to challenge the conviction, as per section 42(2) of the same Act.

IN-STAT-0161.text: No, goods seized for unpaid GST cannot be auctioned on a Sunday. "No sale under the rules under the provision of this chapter shall take place on a Sunday or other general holidays recognized by the Government".

IN-STAT-0162.text: The value of supply of services in case of pure agent shall be excluded from the taxable value, if all the following conditions are satisfied, namely, (i) the supplier acts as a pure agent of the recipient of the supply, when he makes the payment to the third party on authorisation by such recipient; (ii) the payment made by the pure agent on behalf of the recipient of supply has been separately indicated in the invoice issued by the pure agent to the recipient of service; and (iii) the supplies procured by the pure agent from the third party as a pure agent of the recipient of supply are in addition to the services he supplies on his own account.

IN-STAT-0163.text: The Bikaner Development Commissioner, who shall be the Chairman, heads the Bikaner Traffic Control Board as per section 13(2)(i) of the Bikaner Development Authority Act, 2025.

IN-STAT-0165.text: Under section 317 of the Indian Succession Act, 1925, an executor or administrator must exhibit a full inventory of the estate within six months from the grant of probate or letters of administration. This provision applies to the administration of a dead person's estate in Ladakh.

IN-STAT-0166.text: All animals inspected or detained at a quarantine station shall be liable to be vaccinated against any scheduled disease if in the opinion of the officer in charge of such station it is necessary to do so; and to be marked in the prescribed manner.

IN-STAT-0167.text: Under Goa, Daman and Diu Diseases of Animals Act, 1974, Pt. II, s. 30, a veterinary inspector who vexatiously and unnecessarily enters premises or seizes livestock may be fined up to 'five hundred rupees' as per the provision.

IN-STAT-0168.text: No, an advocate cannot speak for someone in a dispute heard by the taluka revenue officer in Goa, as per "no pleader shall be entitled to appear on behalf of any party in any proceedings under this Act before the Mamlatdar" (Provision [5]).

IN-STAT-0169.text: The municipal council must take proper precaution for guarding against accident by shoring up and protecting the adjoining building, and shall cause such bars, chains or posts as it shall think fit, to be fixed across or in any street to prevent the passage of carriages, carts or other vehicle, or of cattle or horses, and shall cause any such construction or repair work in a street to be sufficiently lighted and guarded during the night.

IN-STAT-0170.text: Rules under the law on dissecting unclaimed bodies in Goa may fix the period within which a near relative shall claim the body of a deceased person, as provided in "the period within which a near relative shall claim the body of a deceased person".

IN-STAT-0171.text: The older legislation of the Madhya Bharat Interest Act, 1956 and the Madhya Bharat Treasure Trove Act, Samvat 2006 became the default in the first list.

IN-STAT-0172.text: Yes, it is a crime under the Bihar Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, to issue a bill without supply of goods or services, as it is covered under section 132(1)(b) which states: "issues any invoice or bill without supply of goods or services or both in violation of the provisions of this Act, or the rules made thereunder leading to wrongful availment or utilisation of input tax credit or refund of tax".

IN-STAT-0173.text: The premises of every establishment shall be kept clean and free from effluvia arising from any drain or privy or other nuisance.

IN-STAT-0175.text: The Registrar, Labour Court, the Industrial Court, a Board and a Court of Enquiry under the CHHATTISGARH INDUSTRIAL ACT 1960 have the same powers as are vested in Civil Courts under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, in respect of summoning and enforcing the attendance of any person and examining him on oath, compelling the production of documents.

IN-STAT-0176.text: The reward payable by law when a police officer makes an arrest is paid to such officer, as per 'rewards payable by law for arrests shall, when the arrest is made by a Police officer, be paid to such officer' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0177.text: Every village headman, village accountant, village watchmen or other village official by whatever name called, shall forthwith inform the nearest police station or the nearest Highway Authority, whenever he becomes aware that any boundary mark of any highway has been damaged.

IN-STAT-0178.text: In Jammu and Kashmir, a police officer may defend a prosecution by pleading that the act was done under a warrant issued by a Magistrate, as per 'such plea shall be proved by the production of a warrant directing the act, and purporting to be signed by such Magistrate'.

IN-STAT-0179.text: The Government may restrict the movements of a registered habitual offender for a period not exceeding three years, as specified in the order, provided that the period specified in an order under sub-section (1) shall in no case extend beyond the period of registration or re-registration as the case may be, referred to in section 9.

IN-STAT-0181.text: Whoever fails without reasonable cause to comply with any of the requirements specified in a notification issued under sub-section (1) of section 13 or of a direction issued under sub-section (2) of that section shall be punishable with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees.

IN-STAT-0186.text: Staff hired by the trustees of Kolkata's marble monument to the late Queen are treated as public servants, as per 'All officers and servants employed by the Trustees shall be deemed to be public servants within the meaning of the Indian Penal Code' (provisions [1], [2], [3]). This status does not cover a contractor's workers, as provided by 'the section shall not apply to persons in the service of any contractor employed by the Trustees' (provisions [1], [2], [3]).

IN-STAT-0188.text: The officer running a police station must record 'the day, hour and purpose of visits to the police station of convicts released under the Remission Rule or under Section 565, code of Criminal Procedure' in the station's daily register.

IN-STAT-0189.text: The court may declare the debtor bankrupt again if default is made in the payment of any installment due in pursuance of any composition or scheme, approved as aforesaid, or if it appears to the Court that the composition or scheme cannot proceed without injustice or undue delay or that the approval of the Court was obtained by fraud.

IN-STAT-0191.text: The District Judge, under 'Until probate is granted of the will of a deceased person, or an administrator of his estate is constituted, the District Judge... to take and keep possession of the property' (s. 269(1)), is authorised and required to interfere for the protection of the property at the instance of any person claiming to be interested therein. The Judge shall determine summarily the right to possession and deliver possession accordingly, subject to a suit, as per s. 194.

IN-STAT-0193.text: A High Court judge may choose between leave on full allowances, leave on half allowances, or leave partly on full allowances and partly on half allowances. This is provided under 'Section 3(1) of the High Court Judges Salaries and Conditions of Service Act, 1954.'

IN-STAT-0195.text: The Centre can wind up the Marine Products Export Development Authority only by an order of the Central Government, as per 'No provision of any law relating to the winding up of companies or corporations shall apply to the Authority save by an order of the Central Government' (Provision [4]).

IN-STAT-0196.text: Yes, the ordinary time limits for legal proceedings apply to appeals before the tribunal hearing stock-exchange disputes, as per "The provisions of the Limitation Act, 1963 (36 of 1963) shall, as far as may be, apply to proceedings or appeals before the Tribunal or the Appellate Tribunal, as the case may be."

IN-STAT-0197.text: A state-backed development finance lender may disclose details about its customers' affairs only if required by law or in circumstances customary among bankers. "The Financial Corporation shall not, except as otherwise required by this Act or any other law for the time being in force, divulge any information relating to, or to the affairs of, its constituents" (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0199.text: If a process-server of the presidency-town court for petty claims squeezes money out of people, the Court may inquire into the charge of extortion, and may make an order for the repayment of any money so extorted, and of damages and costs, by such officer, as it thinks fit. 'If any clerk, bailiff or other inferior ministerial officer of the Small Cause Court is charged with extortion or misconduct...the Court may inquire into such charge, and may make such order for the repayment or payment of any money so extorted...as it thinks fit.' [1]

IN-STAT-0202.text: On the commencement of the Act, every obligation of a bonded labourer to repay any bonded debt, or such part of any bonded debt as remains unsatisfied immediately before such commencement, shall be deemed to have been extinguished.

IN-STAT-0204.text: The Unique Identification Authority of India must take special steps to enrol certain category of persons as specified in section 5 of the Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016.

IN-STAT-0205.text: If a territory's seat fell vacant before the old House was dissolved, it shall be filled by a person nominated by the President.

IN-STAT-0207.text: The bench of the body that hears service complaints of soldiers, sailors and airmen is composed of the Court, as per "the Court shall send the summons for service to his commanding officer together with a copy to be retained by the defendant" (citations: [3]).

IN-STAT-0208.text: Section 4 of the Territorial Army Act, 1948 provides for the following classes of persons: 'officers; and enrolled persons.'

IN-STAT-0209.text: The Commissioner appoints municipal officers and other municipal employees, subject to the provisions of section 71. "Subject to the provisions of section 71, the power of appointing municipal officers and other municipal employees whether temporarily or permanent shall vest in the Commissioner." (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0210.text: The Central Government decides the Corporation's provision for depreciation and reserve funds under section 21 of the Faridabad Development Corporation Act, 1956. "The Corporation shall make such provision for depreciation and for reserve and other funds as the Central Government may from time to time direct." (1)

IN-STAT-0211.text: Under section 10 of the Oudh Estates Act, 1869, "None but persons named in lists to be deemed Taluqdárs or Grantees".

IN-STAT-0213.text: No, section 2 of the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 does not displace the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930. "The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to, and not in derogation of, the Dangerous Drugs Act, 1930 (2 of 1930), and any other law for the time being in force."

IN-STAT-0214.text: The Technical Advisory Committee advises the Central Government for the purpose of addition of occupations and processes to the Schedule. The Committee shall consist of a Chairman and such other members not exceeding ten, as may be appointed by the Central Government.

IN-STAT-0215.text: Under section 15(1), the Governing Body has the power to review the acts of the Academic Council. "Subject to the provisions of this Act, the Governing Body of the University shall be responsible for the general policy making, superintendence, direction and control of the affairs of the University and shall exercise all the powers of the University not otherwise provided for by this Act, the Statutes and the Ordinances, and shall have the power to review the acts of the Academic Council."

IN-STAT-0216.text: The heirs of Sir Dinshaw Manockjee Petit to take his name.—The said Framjee Dinshaw Petit and the heirs male of his body and all other the heirs male of the body of the said Sir Dinshaw Manockjee Petit to whom the said title and dignity shall descend, pursuant to the limitations of the Patent whereby the said dignity was granted, shall take upon themselves respectively the names of "Dinshaw Manockjee Petit" in lieu and in the place of any other name or names whatever;

IN-STAT-0219.text: The enactments in the third schedule are in force throughout the whole of the territories now subject to the government of the Governor of Bombay in Council, except the Scheduled Districts subject to such government.

IN-STAT-0220.text: All persons whose names are entered in the register of the Actuarial Society at the commencement of this Act and all persons who may thereafter have their names entered in the register to be maintained under this Act, so long as they continue to have their names borne on the register, are hereby constituted a body corporate by the name of the Institute of Actuaries of India and all such persons shall be known as members of the Institute.

IN-STAT-0222.text: No court shall take cognizance of any offence punishable under this Act, except upon complaint made by order of the Council or a person authorised in this behalf by the Council.

IN-STAT-0223.text: Under section 28 of the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005, the State Government shall, after due appropriation made by Legislature by law in this behalf, pay to the State Commission by way of grants such sums of money as the State Government may think fit for being utilised for the purposes of this Act. 'citations': [1]

IN-STAT-0224.text: The court shall take into account any loss suffered or likely to be suffered by authorised users.

IN-STAT-0225.text: It shall come into force on the 1st day of September, 1943.

IN-STAT-0226.text: The national body regulating engineering and management colleges must convene at least three times in a calendar year, as per 'The Governing Body shall meet at least three times in a calendar year.' In the absence of the head, the meeting shall be chaired by 'any one of the nominees of the Chancellor' as per 'All meetings of the Board of Governors shall always be chaired by the Chancellor and in his absence by any one of the nominees of the Chancellor.'

IN-STAT-0228.text: A person eligible to stand for a state legislature seat set aside for Dalit communities must be a member of any of the castes specified in the Representation of Sikkim Subjects Act, 1974 and an elector for any Assembly constituency in the State.

IN-STAT-0230.text: Under 'Payment by attorney under power, without notice of death, etc., good' [1], the agent is not liable if the payment was made in good faith without knowledge of the principal's death. This section applies only to payments and acts made or done after this Act comes into force.

IN-STAT-0234.text: Yes, the degrees awarded by the national institute for footwear design are recognised as equal to university degrees. 'The Institute shall have the power to grant degrees... which shall be equivalent to such corresponding degrees... granted by any University or Institute established or incorporated under any other law for the time being in force.' (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0235.text: The order of the tribunal deciding complaints about railway freight rates is enforced as per the provisions of the Railways Act, 1989. "The Tribunal shall hear and decide any such complaint in accordance with the provisions of this Chapter."

IN-STAT-0236.text: Yes, a court may confiscate the cart or animal used to carry stolen railway goods, as provided in 'the animals, vehicles, or other conveyances used in carrying the property' under section 13 of the Railway Property (Unlawful Possession) Act, 1966. This is supported by provisions [3].

IN-STAT-0237.text: As from the appointed day and until the first meeting of the Legislative Assembly of a new State other than Kerala, the persons who immediately before the appointed day are the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Legislative Assembly of the corresponding State shall, if they are members of the Legislative Assembly of the new State, be the Speaker and Deputy Speaker, respectively, of that Assembly.

IN-STAT-0238.text: Besides the organisation, the promoter of the society or settlor of the trust, as well as any director, manager, secretary, trustee or other officer of the society or trust who was in charge and responsible for the conduct of its business, are treated as guilty. This is stated in 'every person (including the promoter of society or settlor of the trust) who at the time the offence was committed was in charge of, and was responsible to, the society or trust for the conduct of the business of the society or the trust, as well as the society or trust, shall be deemed to be guilty of the offence' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0239.text: Each State and Union territory having Legislature shall constitute a Board to be known as the State Assisted Reproductive Technology and Surrogacy Board or the Union territory Assisted Reproductive Technology and Surrogacy Board, as the case may be.

IN-STAT-0240.text: The penalty for breaching the 2025 law guaranteeing rural jobs and livelihoods is a fine which may extend to ten thousand rupees.

IN-STAT-0242.text: The punishment for sabotaging air navigation equipment in a way that endangers aircraft in flight is imprisonment for life and fine, as per 'Whoever unlawfully and intentionally destroys or damages air navigation facilities or interferes with their operation in such a manner as is likely to endanger the safety of the aircraft in flight shall be punished with imprisonment for life and shall also be liable to fine' under [1].

IN-STAT-0243.text: No, a tenant cannot grant someone a right of way over the rented land that lasts after the tenancy ends, as the tenancy in respect of the land comprising such way shall be deemed to have been extinguished.

IN-STAT-0245.text: A securities depository acts through participants, as stated in 'Every participant may enter into an agreement with the depository to act as its agent' (provision 3). The relationship is set up through agreements between the participant and the depository, as specified in 'Any participant may enter into an agreement with the depository to act as its agent' (provision 3).

IN-STAT-0246.text: Supply of goods or services imported into the territory of India shall be treated to be a supply of goods or services in the course of inter-State trade or commerce.

IN-STAT-0248.text: The consent must be 'free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with a clear affirmative action' as per section 6(1) of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

IN-STAT-0249.text: Under section 52(1)(b) of the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, the Court shall take judicial notice of international treaties, agreements, or conventions with countries by India, or decisions made by India at international associations or other bodies. This means courts must take notice of such treaties without formal proof.

IN-STAT-0253.text: The National Authority fulfils, on behalf of the Government of India, the obligations under the Convention and acts as the national focal point for effective liaison with the Organization and other States Parties on matters relating to the Convention.

IN-STAT-0254.text: Offences by goods-transport operators can be settled for a fee instead of trial, as per section 129(1) of the Uttar Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017, which states: 'all such goods and conveyance used as a means of transport for carrying the said goods and documents relating to such goods and conveyance shall be liable to detention or seizure and after detention or seizure, shall be released, on payment of the applicable tax and penalty...'. The sum is fixed by the Act itself, as per section 129(1) of the Uttar Pradesh Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017.

IN-STAT-0256.text: A Supreme Court judge may combine vacation on full salary with leave, provided that the leave is taken either at the commencement or at the end of the vacation but not both, as per 'where the vacation consists of one continuous period, the leave is taken either at the commencement or at the end of the vacation but not at both' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0257.text: No, the Centre cannot apply a state's laws to the former Portuguese enclave administered from Silvassa. 'All laws in force in an enclave immediately before the date of transfer shall, as from that date cease to be in force in that enclave' (Provision [7]).

IN-STAT-0260.text: The law in force immediately before the appointed day with respect to the custody of the Seal of the High Court of Assam, Nagaland, Meghalaya, Manipur, Tripura and Mizoram shall, with the necessary modifications, apply with respect to the custody of the Seal of the common High Court.

IN-STAT-0263.text: Section 6 of the Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act, 1937 repeals 'The under mentioned provisions' of the Acts and Regulations mentioned below shall be repealed in so far as they are inconsistent with the provisions of this Act, namely:—

IN-STAT-0264.text: The officer in charge of the prison in which such person is confined.

IN-STAT-0265.text: The Bengal, Agra and Assam Civil Courts Act, 1887 extends to the territories which were on the 11th March, 1887, respectively administered by the Lieutenant-Governor of Bengal, the Lieutenant-Governor of the North-Western Provinces and the Chief Commissioner of Assam, except such portions of those territories as for the time being are not subject to the ordinary civil jurisdiction of the High Court.

IN-STAT-0266.text: Each Registrar General of Births, Deaths and Marriages shall cause indexes of all the certified copies of registers sent to his office under this Act, or under Act 3 of 18721 the Indian Christian Marriage Act, 1872 (15 of 1872), or the Parsi Marriage and Divorce Act, 18652 (15 of 1865), as amended by this Act, to be made and kept in his office in the prescribed form.

IN-STAT-0268.text: Under section 13 of the Indian Naval Armament Act, 1923, no Court inferior to that of a Presidency Magistrate or Magistrate of the first class shall proceed to the trial of any offence punishable under this Act, and no Court shall proceed to the trial of any such offence except on complaint made by, or under authority from, the Central Government.

IN-STAT-0270.text: Arrested persons to be made over to the police.

IN-STAT-0271.text: The rulings of the national body developing river and canal shipping routes are made official by notification in the Official Gazette, as provided in 'by notification in the Official Gazette' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0272.text: Yes, the tribunal hearing appeals in telephone and internet disputes must follow the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, as the tribunal shall have the same powers as are vested in a civil court under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 (Central Act No. V of 1908) in respect of hearing and deciding of an appeal or any dispute referred to it.

IN-STAT-0273.text: No, the Union government cannot fund itself with loans from the Mumbai-based monetary authority. "The Metropolitan Authority may, with the previous approval of the State Government, borrow any moneys" (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0274.text: Yes, under Section 66(3)(n) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, transport vehicles carrying relief supplies in natural calamities are exempt from permit requirements. 'the provisions of sub-section (1) of the said section shall not apply to a transport vehicle used for carriage of food grains and other relief supplies for the persons affected by natural calamities'.

IN-STAT-0275.text: It may be presumed that such books of account or other documents, articles or things including money belong to such person.

IN-STAT-0280.text: If a plant breeder deliberately hides that a new crop variety was developed from seeds kept by village or tribal communities, the Registrar may reject the application for registration under section 40(2), and the breeder may face penalties under section 70 or 71 for wilful concealment or false indication of origin.

IN-STAT-0281.text: Yes, a wife may sue on her own to recover property that is legally hers alone, as 'A married woman may maintain a suit in her own name for the recovery of property of any description which, by force of the said Indian Succession Act, 1865 or of this Act, is her separate property' (Provision 1).

IN-STAT-0282.text: The owner may redeem the animal within forty-eight hours after its seizure by paying the fine and feeding and maintenance charges as prescribed, as per 'the owner may redeem the animal or bird within a period of forty-eight hours after its seizure paying to the local authority, such fine and such feeding and maintenance charges as may be prescribed' (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0283.text: No, an unregistered ship brought to India to be broken up cannot be put on the Indian register. "Where a vessel has ceased to be registered as an Indian vessel by reason of having been wrecked or abandoned, or for any reason other than capture by the enemy, the vessel shall not be re-registered until she has, at the expense of the applicant, been surveyed by a surveyor and certified by him to be seaworthy." [3].

IN-STAT-0285.text: The proprietor of such carriage shall be liable to every such penalty as if he had been the driver of such carriage or owner of such horse at the time when such offence was committed.

IN-STAT-0286.text: Under 'Section 8 of the Aadhaar (Sharing of Information) Regulations, 2016', the Aadhaar number holder may raise queries and grievances in accordance with regulation 32 of the Aadhaar (Enrolment and Update) Regulations, 2016.

IN-STAT-0287.text: Ten working days’ notice shall be given to the firm holding pension scheme assets before an inspection or audit, unless the Authority is satisfied that such inspection or audit is required for immediate safeguarding of the interest of the subscribers. "ten working days’ notice" (Provisions [1], [2], [3], [4], [5], [6], [7], [8]).

IN-STAT-0289.text: The Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (Procedure for Authority Meetings) Regulations, 2015 provide that the Authority shall meet 'not less than four times in a year'.

IN-STAT-0290.text: Both the holder of the electronic negotiable warehouse receipt and the pledgee must instruct the repository.

IN-STAT-0291.text: The waste containing chemicals mentioned in rule 2 shall be disposed of as per the provisions of the Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016.

IN-STAT-0292.text: If a postal remittance can't be delivered, the sender gets the fee back along with the money, as per 'The undelivered money order shall be returned to the remitter and the amount of the money order shall be paid to the remitter excluding the commission thereof.' (citation: 1).

IN-STAT-0294.text: A male candidate who has more than one wife living shall not be eligible for appointment to a post in the service "provided that the Board may, if satisfied that there exist special grounds for doing, so exempt any person from the operation of this regulation." (citations: [1])

IN-STAT-0295.text: If part of the Hyderabad museum board's central grant is unspent at year end, it is not lost. 'If any sum granted by the Central Government remains wholly or partly unspent in any financial year, the unspent sum may be carried forward to the next financial year and taken into account in determining the sum to be provided by the Central Government for that year.' (2)

IN-STAT-0298.text: Under section 7 of the Rehabilitation Finance Administration Act, 1948, a member must "immediately disclose it to the Administration and shall either resign his membership or disclose of his interest in such manner and within such time as he may be directed by it."

IN-STAT-0300.text: If the area of the society’s operations is limited to the transferred territories, be a liability of the State to which the territories are transferred.

IN-STAT-0302.text: Section 7 of the Chandigarh Disturbed Areas Act, 1983 repeals "The Chandigarh Disturbed Areas Ordinance, 1983 (6 of 1983)".

IN-STAT-0305.text: The Principal Commissioner of Customs or Commissioner of Customs, as the case may be, may issue a licence to run a special bonded warehouse for imported goods.

IN-STAT-0307.text: The lowest rank of officer who can sign off the anti-corruption watchdog's orders is an officer not below the rank of an Under Secretary, as per 'Orders and decisions of the Commission shall be authenticated by an officer of the Commission not below the rank of an Under Secretary' (citation: 6).

IN-STAT-0308.text: No, the bank cannot hand over subscriber data to others at will. 'A financial service provider may disclose personal information relating to a subscriber to a third party only if' (Provision [2]).

IN-STAT-0309.text: Grid-use fees for consumers buying power from other suppliers for short periods in Himachal Pradesh are fixed at a fixed rate of Rs. 5.00 per kWh of the energy to be settled in case of consumers covered under single part tariff and at a fixed rate Rs. 4.50 per kVAh in case of consumers covered under two parts tariff.

IN-STAT-0310.text: If the Chairman of the Jharkhand Electricity Regulatory Commission cannot attend, any other member nominated by the Chairman shall preside at the meeting/proceeding.

IN-STAT-0311.text: The issue of preference shares shall be in accordance with the guidelines framed by the Reserve Bank specifying the class of preference shares, the extent of issue of each class of such preference shares (whether perpetual or irredeemable or redeemable) and the terms and conditions subject to which, each class of preference shares may be issued.

IN-STAT-0313.text: Yes, the officer can demand a guarantor. 'the proper officer may, where the duty finally assessed or re-assessed is in excess of the duty provisionally assessed, require the importer to execute a bond, binding himself in a sum equal to twice the amount of the excess duty.' (citations: [2])

IN-STAT-0314.text: Every Member shall submit at each meeting of the Authority a Specific Declaration of Interest in Schedule I, which might be considered prejudicial to their independence in relation to any of the items on the agenda.

IN-STAT-0315.text: The Tahsildar or the authorized officer shall on receipt of the order of the Court issue or arrange to issue a direction in Form –V deputing any officer not below the rank of a Revenue Inspector to take possession of the grabbed land on behalf of the Court and deliver possession of the land to the person ordered by the Court.

IN-STAT-0316.text: In Goa, a firm aggrieved by the industrial estate corporation's refusal of a plot transfer shall approach the Grievance Redressal Authority appointed by the Board of Directors of the Corporation, as per "any applicant affected by the decision of the Corporation or its refusal, shall approach the Grievance Redressal Authority appointed by the Board of Directors of the Corporation" (Provisions [3] and [4]).

IN-STAT-0318.text: When the Reserves are called up, officers who are abroad shall receive notice thereof from the Registrar of Reserves or the nearest Indian representative. They shall then present themselves abroad the first Indian Naval Ship they meet and also report by letter to the Registrar of Reserves in India and to the nearest Indian representative.

IN-STAT-0319.text: The papers companies file with the government are stored in a secure electronic registry as per 'The Central Government shall set up and maintain a secure electronic registry in which all the applications, financial statement, prospectus, return, register, memorandum, articles, particulars of charges, or any particulars or returns or any other documents filed under the Act to be electronically stored' (citation: [4]).

IN-STAT-0320.text: The Stock Disposal Register in Form 5 records securities returned to the administrator(s) or otherwise disposed of by the Treasurer, as per 'The Treasurer shall maintain a Stock Disposal Register in Form 5, wherein he shall enter all securities returned to the administrator(s) or otherwise disposed of by him.' [2]

IN-STAT-0322.text: A Revision shall lie to the Commissioner of Land Administration against the orders of the Collector under Rule 9 and a second revision to the Government against the orders of the Commissioner of Land Administration.

IN-STAT-0323.text: The licence fee shall be paid in cash at the time of presenting the application or by remitting it by postal money order addressed to the Assistant Registrar or by crediting to Government account at a Treasury, or the Reserve Bank of India, and forwarding the receipt of the postal money order or the receipted chalan to the Assistant Registrar along with the application.

IN-STAT-0324.text: Electricity tax recovered in excess, if any, during the month may either be adjusted in future bills or refunded, subject to verification, by the licensee in case of sale. 'Notice of final Assessment and Refund Order / Refund Adjustment Order shall be in FormJ.'

IN-STAT-0326.text: Yes, an app can let users verify themselves with Aadhaar to create a digital health ID, as per 'Entities which are desirous of allowing voluntary Aadhaar authentication as one of the options for users to create health ID... shall be permitted to do so' (Provision [1]).

IN-STAT-0328.text: The shop owner gets back the 'registration certificate' after notifying the authorities of their establishment.

IN-STAT-0329.text: The State Board enforces the rules on used car batteries, and it must file an annual compliance status report to the Central Pollution Control Board by '30th April of every year' as per rule 12 (Prescribed Authority) of the Batteries (Management and Handling) Rules, 2001.

IN-STAT-0330.text: Money collected as fines for polluting rivers ends up in the 'Environmental Protection Fund established under 16 of the Act' as per 'Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 — Ch. VII, s. 45D' and is credited to the 'Environment Protection Fund established under 16 of the Act' as per 'Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) (Manner of Holding Inquiry and Imposition of Penalty) Rules, 2024. s. 7 Order and penalties (2)'

IN-STAT-0332.text: The pound-keeper shall remit the fines realised for straying livestock to the District Magistrate, in the manner prescribed.
